candidate_relations.reason: The splenic biopsy supports DLBCL and the CD10-negative/MUM1-positive profile is compatible with an activated B-cell/non-germinal-center phenotype; however, the benchmark diagnostic object specifically requires HIV-associated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the spleen.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies DLBCL with activated B-cell phenotype but omits the required HIV association and splenic primary site.
